geometricComponents.note: a stub endpoint lying in the interior of the bus segment counts as joined (T junction)

mechanism.why: Line packs four numbers per segment (x1,y1,x2,y2). Reading two at a time turns the end of one segment into the start of the next, inventing an edge that no wire draws. Those invented edges stitch the separate stubs and the bus into one component, so the old run reported no disconnected net.

t38Line109.semantics: The union-find is not segment enumeration: it unions endpoints, so it answers 'which endpoints are joined by a drawn segment'. That question is still stride-sensitive - with stride 2 it unions endpoints that no segment joins.
t38Line109.doesTheConclusionChange: yes for the number, no for the claim 'the net is not broken'. The endpoint reading gives 4/3 blocks; the geometric reading (T junction counts) gives 1/1, so the drawing is connected. The published [] was right by accident and wrong by derivation.
